subject: Request: anonymized admin log snapshot for SIG / SOC 2 review
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novamed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Novamed Audits <security@novamed.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: anonymized admin log snapshot for SIG / SOC 2 review

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As part of our SIG and SOC 2 readiness work we need a short, tightly-scoped deliverable from Redwood: an anonymized admin-activity snapshot covering the last 90 days that shows admin actions (role changes, key rotations, model pin/rollback events, account-to-role mappings) plus a manifest proving integrity.

Specifically we need:
- A compact archive (parquet or JSONL) with column-level PII redaction (user emails replaced with hashed IDs)
- A manifest with per-file SHA256 and a HMAC over the manifest (we'll provide the verification key)
- Delivery via pre-signed HTTPS links (single-use preferred) or SFTP if you support it
- A short attestation that the extract scope includes all admin-console actions and whether ephemeral traces (prefix/KV cache events) were excluded

Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood can produce the above within 72 hours of acceptance, and 2) how you handle redaction salts (reversible vs irreversible) for SIG reviewers?

Attach: SIG questionnaire (we've highlighted the relevant control IDs). Procurement will sign once scope and SLA are clarified.

Best,
Elaine
Audit Lead, Novamed Therapeutics

Attachment: sig_questionnaire.pdf (pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novamed.com>
Cc: Novamed Audits <security@novamed.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: anonymized admin log snapshot for SIG / SOC 2 review

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list. We can do this. Two practical delivery options (pros/cons below) and a recommended default to balance auditability and PII protection: 

Option A — Full signed snapshot (recommended for SOC 2):
- Export all admin events for the requested window as Parquet with column-level masking (email -> salted hash, user_id -> redacted_user_id).
- Provide manifest.csv with per-file SHA256, plus manifest.hmac.sha256 signed with our export HMAC key.
- Delivery: pre-signed HTTPS URLs (time-limited) generated per file, single-use flag and 7-day link validity.
- Pros: complete evidence, easy for auditors to query. Cons: larger payload, requires accepted attestation.

Option B — Sampled/anonymized extract for SIG reviewers:
- Representative sample (configurable percentage) where PII fields are irreversibly hashed (salted with per-customer secret stored in KMS).
- Lower footprint and safer to share early in sales/PS discussions.

Notes / questions:
- We treat prefix/KV cache hits as transient telemetry and do not include them by default; we can include them if Novamed wants full-forensic chain.
- Redaction: by default we use irreversible salted hashes (one-way, per-customer salt in KMS). For SIG reviewers who need mapping, we can provide a sealed mapping file under a separate attestation process — would you or your auditor require reversible mapping?

Attached a short export scope CSV and presign workflow doc. If you confirm Option A and the 72-hour SLA we will kick an export ticket and route to Marissa (operations) for the HMAC signing step.

Next step: please reply with preferred option and whether Novamed requires reversible mapping.

Regards,
Soojin
Senior Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: export_scope.csv, presign_instructions.md
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novamed.com>, Novamed Audits <security@novamed.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: anonymized admin log snapshot for SIG / SOC 2 review

Thanks — quick tech details that will affect the package and timeline: 

- Format and schema: we can emit Parquet (preferred) or JSONL. Parquet will include column-level schemas and is smaller.
- PII handling: we perform SHA256(user_email || customer_salt) with a per-customer salt stored in KMS; the salt is not exported. This yields irreversible hashes. For auditors that need mapping, we can offer a sealed mapping encrypted with the customer's public key and stored in our evidence S3; retrieval requires a signed request and 2FA by our ops lead.
- Scope: admin events we include by default — role.create/update/delete, iam.policy.attach/detach, key.rotate, model.pin/unpin, deployment. Operator telemetry (short-lived KV cache touches) is excluded unless explicitly requested.
- Retention: Redwood retains admin logs for 365 days internally; export window can be any subset. Snapshots delivered to customers are ephemeral; presigned links expire after default 7 days. We can increase presign TTL or use SFTP for long-lived delivery.
- Integrity: manifest.csv with per-file SHA256 plus manifest.hmac.sha256 using an HMAC key that we will rotate monthly. We'll provide HMAC verification instructions and the public verification fingerprint.

If Novamed confirms they want the full-forensic package, we estimate 48 hours from approval to delivery (48-72 safe window if mapping/sealing is required).

-Kimberly
Director, Platform Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novamed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, Novamed Audits <security@novamed.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: anonymized admin log snapshot for SIG / SOC 2 review

Soojin / Kimberly —

Thanks, this sounds good. Novamed prefers Option A (full signed snapshot) with irreversible hashing for shared artifacts — our audit team does not require reversible mappings at this stage. A few clarifications before procurement signs: 
- SLA: we need an on-demand egress SLA of 48 hours after approval. Is that acceptable?
- Evidence scope: please confirm role changes, key rotations, model pin/unpin, and admin console login failures are included. We do not require KV cache events.
- Delivery: presigned HTTPS links are fine; procurement will want a DocuSign with the acceptance of the export terms and a standard export attestation.

If you confirm 48 hours + manifest and HMAC as described, procurement will sign the DocuSign today.

Best,
Elaine

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novamed.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: anonymized admin log snapshot for SIG / SOC 2 review

Hi Elaine — Marissa here from Ops. Confirming plan and next steps: 

1) Scope confirmed: role changes, key rotations, model pin/unpin, admin login failures. KV / prefix cache events excluded.
2) Delivery plan: full Parquet snapshot, manifest.csv (per-file SHA256), and manifest.hmac.sha256. Links will be pre-signed HTTPS, single-use, 7-day default.
3) Retention & SLA: we will produce the snapshot within 48 hours of your signed DocuSign acceptance. Internal retention remains 365 days; exported artifacts will be accessible via presigned links for 7 days. If you request longer delivery TTL we can provide SFTP or extend presign TTL — let us know.
4) Integrity & attestation: attached attestation-snapshot.txt describes the signing process and includes the HMAC fingerprint. We'll also include manifest.hmac.sha256 in the bundle.

Action items:
- Elaine / Procurement: sign the DocuSign (link below).
- After sign: I will open export ticket EX-43821, trigger the job, and send the presigned URLs to your security mailbox.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/novamed-export-agreement-xyz
Ticket: EX-43821

Thanks — we'll standby for the signed DocuSign and will target delivery within 48 hours thereafter.

-Marissa Cole
